title: ollama-cria secret inventory (manifests/secrets.json)
description: Every secret file the stack needs, by name and logical location only: never a value. tools/Collect-StackSecrets.ps1 collects exactly these rows (review findings C-06, C-07, C-10). Logical locations use the roots in manifests/recovery-roots.json.

audits.description: Folders that must hold no file without a row. A file found there with no row stops the collector.

location.description: Logical location '<root>:<relative path>'. The file is collected from here and restored to the same place.

id.description: Stable name for the row. Becomes the restore-map id.

kind.description: file: copied as is. sqlite: copied with SQLite's backup API and integrity-checked (volume roots only).

required.description: A missing required row stops the collector and the restore; a missing optional row only warns (C-07).

mode.description: Linux file mode for VPS rows, for example 0600.

purpose.description: What the file is for and what breaks without it. Never a value.
